headline: Jets QB Klubnik unshaken by fall in draft: 'I'm a winner'

headline: Schefter: Packers release kicker Brandon McManus
description: Adam Schefter tells Pat McAfee the Packers released kicker Brandon McManus after drafting Florida kicker Trey Smack in the sixth round.
